newsitem.title: PERU: RESEARCH ALERT - J.P. Morgan ups Telefonica target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - J.P. Morgan ups Telefonica target.

text.p: J.P. Morgan analyst Simon Flannery raised the company's 12-month target price for Telefonica del Peru to $30 from $27 and reiterated its buy recommendation.
"We continue to believe that TDP is one of the most attractive stocks in our universe with rapid growth potential and a high-quality regulatory environment," he wrote in a report.

"TDP is, along with Telebras, one of the few Latin telecom operators that can avoid the mature label; having only been privatized since 1994 (versus 1990/91 for most others), there is plenty of growth potential left."
He added that line penetration was only six per 100 people, compared to a regional average of 10.
Flannery also predicted 20 percent earnings growth over the next three years, driven by 17 percent line growth and productivity improvement.

Expense growth, however, "may again keep a lid on earnings in the short run," the report added. "But over time, we believe that TDP will be able to report some of the best earnings growth in the region."
